expected_response.discriminating_condition: a registered recipe whose executing scalar contains the pair-kernel or internal-contrast term, or a validated time-conditioned fit with accepted polynomial and no extrapolation

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A to 0.5 or 2.0 would change the robust curvature of the executing pointcloud scalar without any supplied evidence tying that curvature to the pair-kernel or internal-contrast signals; the Analyst's pair-kernel hypothesis is not expressible by this scalar, so the edit would displace coordinates without a supported observable response.

Editing region_index to emphasize a landmark would rest on global centroid or single-landmark marginals that do not survive multiplicity adjustment (branch_adjusted:0/1/2/77/78/79) and would risk unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates.

Editing teacher_neighbors to 2 or 8 would change mode coverage without evidence: joint diagnostics show internal contrast dominates (0.787) and innovation association with observed child score gain is negative (joint_diagnostics:2), so narrower or broader neighborhoods are not supported.

Editing temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend would rely on time-conditioned fits that are not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, extrapolation_allowed=false) and on curves with weak late-window fidelity (curve_support), risking a temporal derivative being misread as a spatial gradient.

Treating survival enrichment or turnover residuals as final affinity benefit would substitute recorded joint-head credit and accounting diagnostics for decoded terminal affinity, which is unavailable.
rationale: Retain the incumbent (D2_without_trajectory_static, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, mixture_temperature=0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0). No registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective. (1) The Analyst's strongest reproducible coordinate signals are pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 shell densities (endpoint_effects:9/10; branch_adjusted:86/87/240/241), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no permitted parameter (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) changes that observable; the Analyst itself flags this as descriptive only. (2) Global centroid coordinates do not survive adjustment (branch_adjusted:0/1/2/77/78/79), so no region_index emphasis is justified. (3) The most reproducible negative signals (shape_yy, landmark_06 occupancy; branch_adjusted:158/235/187/188/264/265) argue against adding emphasis, not for it. (4) Joint diagnostics show the signal is internal (0.787) rather than rigid (0.132/0.081) and innovation association with observed child score gain is negative (joint_diagnostics:2), so no teacher_neighbors or blend change is supported. (5) Continuous contrast fits are not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, extrapolation_allowed=false, relative_node_rmse 0.29-0.87, strong sign conflicts; continuous:0-9, curve_support), so no temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit is supported. (6) Turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics, not causal selection effects (turnover:1/2/14/17/47/134/224/497), and increment contrasts are mostly weak after adjustment (increment_effects:3/4/7/10/14/15). (7) Survival soft-mass enrichment is coverage-limited (349 nodes <3 ancestors, 531 <6; lineage_support) and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available), so descendant credit cannot be treated as final affinity benefit. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a registered recipe whose executing scalar contains the pair-kernel or internal-contrast term, or a validated time-conditioned fit with accepted polynomial and no extrapolation.
